title: Tangential Jacobian as the square root of an ambient Gram determinant
statement: Let N, N′ ∈ ℕ and let T ⊆ ℝᴺ be a linear subspace with orthogonal projection P := T.starProjection : ℝᴺ → ℝᴺ and inclusion ι_T : T → ℝᴺ. Let A : ℝᴺ → ℝ^{N′} be a continuous linear map with adjoint A*. Then areaJacobian(A ∘ ι_T) = √det(I − P + P ∘ A* ∘ A ∘ P), where the determinant on the right is that of the linear endomorphism I − P + PA*AP of ℝᴺ, and areaJacobian(L) = √det(L*L).
lean_statement: ∀ (N N' : ℕ) (T : Submodule ℝ (Rn N)) (A : Rn N →L[ℝ] Rn N'), areaJacobian (A.comp T.subtypeL) = Real.sqrt ((1 - T.starProjection + T.starProjection ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint A ∘L A ∘L T.starProjection).det)
